facts.goal: Obtain food newly acquired from the world and eat it while preserving your health. Eating initial supplies alone does not complete this goal. Choose your own tools and direction from actual observations.

planningPhase.instruction: Plan what to do AFTER this identified ongoing movement succeeds and physically stops. These are deferred candidates, not commands to execute now. Current busy status alone is not a reason to return no steps. Choose goals/actions yourself; an empty plan remains legal. Do not cancel the predecessor in this plan.
planningPhase.evidenceRule: Observations, references and inventory describe the actual current world, NOT predicted arrival. Do not invent future items, positions, references or outcomes. Execution requires real predecessor success, stopped motion, fresh observation/schema and native validation; stale or failed plans are discarded.

predecessor.goal: Approach actually visible cooked-meat drop; collection not yet claimed

actualStatus.completion_meaning: Arrived requires the observed local route and settled completion; failed navigation may still have made partial progress. Path is traveled distance, Remaining is endpoint distance.

planningPhase.deadlineRule: Decision budget does not extend the preceding action. Host monotonic deadline and cancellation remain authoritative.

coverage.note: VisibleBlockTotal counts only observed non-air cells inside the bounded scan, not hidden world contents. OmittedBlocks is output truncation; incomplete scans may contain additional unknown cells. Entity/pickable truncation signals additional sensed results, not their total count. Pickable sense distinguishes vision and proximity. Position is an actual visible sample; Face may be unknown. Action reach and native prerequisites still apply.

navigation.completion_meaning: Arrived requires the observed local route and settled completion; failed navigation may still have made partial progress. Path is traveled distance, Remaining is endpoint distance.

facts.host: Host supplies actual state and terminal statuses. Queries are bounded projections; omitted results are not facts. Use fresh named tools only.

manual.note: Static public item labels, not possessions or a plan. Native recipe and storage queries provide actual requirements and slot roles.

data.completion_meaning: Arrived requires the observed local route and settled completion; failed navigation may still have made partial progress. Path is traveled distance, Remaining is endpoint distance.

offers.Name: read_environment
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Read local light, weather and time.

offers.Name: read_storage
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Read actual slots and crafting preview or furnace heat/fuel/progress. Furnaces process matching ingredients with sufficient native heat/fuel over time, not act_Craft.

offers.Name: read_map
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Read historical positions with lastSeenGameTime. Only navigation, not evidence of current resources. Page offsets use mutable live LRU order; re-observe after arrival.

offers.Name: read_item
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Read the entry for a known item.

offers.Name: find_items
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Search items you know about.

offers.Name: find_creatures
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Search creatures you know about.

offers.Name: find_recipes
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Read recipe knowledge: materials, grid/station and heat requirements. Recipe existence does not mean supplies or a usable station exist.

offers.Name: act_MoveTo
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Move to an observed or remembered location, or explore with bearing and distance.

offers.Name: act_FaceTowards
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Aim at a currently observed location, or turn by relative bearing with optional head pitch.

offers.Name: act_Jump
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Jump once using native locomotion.

offers.Name: act_Wait
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Wait for game time to pass.

offers.Name: act_Eat
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Consume current owned food; slot/value/count alternatives are paired from this inventory. Initial supplies remain available.

offers.Name: act_Sleep
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Try to fall asleep at the current place.

offers.Name: act_WakeUp
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Wake up.

offers.Name: act_PickUp
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Pick up a visible dropped stack or food within reach.

offers.Name: act_SelectItem
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Select a held inventory slot.

offers.Name: act_TransferItems
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Move existing items. source_value is source slot CURRENT value; destination_value is destination slot CURRENT value (0 if empty), not the transferred item.

offers.Name: act_Dig
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Dig the observed block.

offers.Name: act_Place
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Place the held block against an observed face.

offers.Name: act_Craft
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Collect result from an already correctly arranged crafting grid. Does not fill ingredients. Grid crafting cannot heat/cook food.

offers.Name: host_navigate_local
offers.Description: After predecessor SUCCESS and fresh validation only. Bounded local navigation 1-4m. Absolute world bearing: 0=+Z, 90=+X. Does not promise arrival; inspect actual status.
